preDevolution.heading: UK Unified Statutary Rating Framework (Pre-Devolution: 1990–2004)
preDevolution.statute: Local Government Finance Act 1988 (LGFA 1988 s.43, s.45, s.58)
preDevolution.overview: Afore the Local Government Act 2003 reforms that tuik effect on 1 Aprile 2005, Ingland operatit unner the oreeginal unified Great Breetain non-domestic rating framewark enactit bi Pairliament in the LGFA 1988.
rules: Single Unified Multiplier: A single non-domestic multiplier (e.g. 34.8p in 1990/91) applied tae aw non-domestic hereditaments. Nae smaw business multiplier existit.
Nae Smaw Business Relief: Smaw Business Rate Relief (SBRR) didnae exist. Ilka property, regairdless o bouk, peyed pure gross liability (Rateable Value × Single Multiplier).

Symmetrical 5-Year Transitional Phasing: Revaluations unner LGFA 1988 s.58 featurt upwaird caps (+15%/+20%) fundit bi dounwaird reduction caps that delayed bill reductions for fawin-value properties, indexit tae annual RPI.

Pre-2008 Tuim Property Rules: Tuim commercial premises gat 3 month 100% exemption, syne peyed 50% rates indefinitely; industrial hereditaments haed 100% permanent exemption till the Rating (Empty Properties) Act 2007 imposed 100% tuim liability on 1 Aprile 2008.

rules: Unified National Multiplier: Wales shared a single non-domestic multiplier set nationally (e.g. 36.8p in 1990/91, 39.0p in 1995/96) wi nae smaw business differentiation.

preDevolution.overview: Afore devolution unner the Scotland Act 1998 an the subsequent shapin o the Small Business Bonus Scheme (SBBS) on 1 Aprile 2008, non-domestic rates in Scotland were managed unner the UK Scots Office framewark.
rules: Single Scots Poundage: A single uniform poundage rate (e.g. 52.5p in 1990/91, 43.2p in 1995/96) wis set bi the Secretar o State for Scotland, applied uniformly athort aw commercial properties.
Pre-SBBS Era: Nae universal smaw business relief existit till the pilot Small Business Rate Relief Scheme (SBRRS) in 2003, that wis replaced bi SBBS in 2008.
Symmetrical Transitional Phasing: Scots revaluations featurt symmetrical transitional phasing schemes cappin annual poundage shifts wi upwaird limits an dounwaird delay caps.
Pre-2008 Tuim Rating: 3 month initial tuim property exemption follaed bi 50% indefinite rating.
